2. To determine the dose of each drug for this specific patient, I would use the patient's weight and renal function. I would calculate the dose based on the patient's weight, and adjust it according to her renal function, which can be estimated using the Cockcroft-Gault equation or the Modification of Diet in Renal Disease (MDRD) equation. For example, if the patient weighs 60 kg and has a creatinine clearance of 40 mL/min, I would use the calculated dose and adjust it to 50% of the standard dose to account for her renal impairment.
